Container.Name: YadVault-DB
Container.Overview: The database of YadVault (PostgreSQL 16 with pgvector). Install it first, on the custom Docker network "yadvault", then the YadVault container on the same network. Choose the password (letters and digits) and use the same one in YadVault's database address.
Container.Requires: The custom Docker network "yadvault" (docker network create yadvault).

Config.Name: Database files
Config.Description: Where the database keeps its files (appdata on the cache pool is best).

Config.Name: Database user
Config.Description: Keep it: YadVault's database address uses it.

Config.Name: Database name
Config.Description: Keep it: YadVault's database address uses it.

Config.Name: Database password
Config.Description: Letters and digits. The same password goes into YadVault's database address.

Config.Name: Checksums
Config.Description: Data checksums when the database is created.
